title: Fix harden-runner egress allowlist typo blocking pre-commit CI check
description: The step-security/harden-runner allowed-endpoints list in .github/workflows/tests.yml contains 'production.cloudflare.docker.com:443' but Docker Hub's real image-layer CDN redirect is 'production.cloudfront.docker.com:443'. This blocks docker pull of rhysd/actionlint (used by the pre-commit hook), which fails the required 'pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest' branch-protection check on every PR. Currently blocking 9 open dependency-update PRs (#978, #980, #982-986, #988, #989) plus indirectly PR #870.
design: Single-line domain fix in .github/workflows/tests.yml. Root cause confirmed via CI job logs (docker pull DNS lookup denied by harden-runner egress policy) and branch protection required_status_checks config.
acceptance_criteria: allowed-endpoints in tests.yml corrected to production.cloudfront.docker.com:443; pre-commit 3.12 / ubuntu-latest check passes on a PR touching this file; previously-blocked dependency PRs re-run green.
